candidates.change_summary: Change the function selector from transferFrom to transfer, altering which function is called on caddress.
Replace the success requirement with an assignment that ignores the call result, allowing the loop to continue even if a sub-call fails.
Return false instead of true when the function completes successfully.
Remove the require check on _tos.length > 0, allowing empty arrays which changes revert behavior.
Replace the require on internal call success with assignment to a bool, causing the function to return true even if a sub-call fails.
Replace the return value with false, changing the observable boolean result after a successful transfer.
Change the function selector to a different function signature, causing the external call to target a different function or revert.
Replace 'from' with 'msg.sender' in the call encoding, altering the source address used in the transferFrom call.
